COMMONWEALTH OF PENNSYLVANIA
                        PENNSYLVANIA PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION
                                 400 NORTH STREET
                                HARRISBURG, PA 17120

                                    October 15, 2026

Via Electronic Filing
The Honorable Debbie-Anne A. Reese, Secretary
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
888 First Street, N.E.
Washington, D.C. 20426

       Re:    Request to Update Information and Official Service List

Secretary Reese:

        Pursuant to Rules 2010 and 2101 of the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (“FERC”), the Pennsylvania Public Utility
Commission notifies the FERC of a change in appearance and requests that FERC
modify the existing service list for each proceeding identified in Appendix A to reflect
the following:

PLEASE REMOVE AS COUNSEL

Elizabeth H. Barnes, Esquire
Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission
400 North Street, Third Floor
Harrisburg, PA 17120
ebarnes@pa.gov

      If you have any questions regarding this request, please contact the undersigned.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.


       Respectfully submitted,

       /s/ Elizabeth Barnes
       Elizabeth H. Barnes
